items.briefing:
Online scams continue to be a growing concern for Australian staff and the public, with reports highlighting an increasing volume of fraudulent websites and blogs designed to deceive everyday users. It's worth staying alert to suspicious links or offers that appear in emails, search results, or social media. Separately, OpenAI has launched a Computer History feature in ChatGPT for macOS, which stores your activity — a reminder to be mindful of what work-related information you share with AI tools.

**Practical tip:** Avoid entering sensitive work or personal information into AI chat tools unless your organisation has explicitly approved them for that purpose.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical vulnerability backlog leaves Australian organisations dangerously exposed to active threats.
